name: Lockable Button
description: An on signal must be sent to the button's unlock node to allow player interaction. The button's default state can be configured by selecting it with the select component.
shortDescription: A toggle button that can only be interacted with when unlocked.

logicNodes.label: Unlock
logicNodes.description: Allows the button to be interacted with when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Toggled
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on/off signal that can be toggled by interacting with [$[action_interact_left]]/[$[action_interact_right]] when unlocked.
